verdict.rationale: Snyk Open Source explicitly scans dependency licenses for compliance against known licenses (snyk-docs-20), and the platform advertises general 'Policy management' features (snyk-docs-32), implying license policy enforcement capability. However, the evidence never details concrete license-policy enforcement mechanics (e.g., failing builds/PRs on license violations, custom license policy rules) and lacks independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific workflow. Missing for 10: explicit enforcement workflow details (build/PR gating on license violations), documented custom license policy configuration, and independent confirmation of license-policy enforcement in practice.
